pora.name: Pora na paru
pora.label: My own product · since 2024
pora.text: A timetable for universities. I began with VCourse, tested the idea on real users and am building the product again from scratch.
pora.role: Design, iOS, Android and web: me. Backend: my co-founder.

service.title: One service for a whole university
service.text: A university keeps its timetable in one place, and students and teachers see changes in every app at once.

apps.title: Native on iOS and on Android
apps.text: Not one layout for two platforms: each has its own gestures, widgets and system features.

editor.title: Publishing without conflicts
editor.text: The editor catches clashes before anything is published. Move a lesson yourself: the rule is real, the data is made up.

origin.title: It began with VCourse
origin.text: The first version shipped on iOS, Android and the web and was tested by real users.

week.conflict: Conflict: two lessons in one slot

flow.name: Flow
flow.label: iOS app design · since 2026
flow.text: A system of my own: agents, a terminal and a Markdown knowledge base carry a task from the brief to finished screens.
flow.note: The tasks in the demo are made up.

brief.title: Brief
brief.text: A task becomes a short brief and a list of questions.

research.title: Research
research.text: References from real apps, a breakdown of patterns and a map of screens.

screens.title: Screens
screens.text: An agent assembles screens from base tokens and components, and I make the decisions.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.text: The finished file goes to development.

base.title: Back to the base
base.text: Review notes become rules in the knowledge base, and the next task starts from them.

projects.name: Projects
projects.label: Everything else

site.title: This site
site.text: A portfolio built like a product: Next.js, GSAP, a theme system of its own, strict checks before every commit.

thesis.title: A thesis in LaTeX
thesis.text: A bachelor's thesis as a code project: LuaLaTeX, GOST formatting, PDF builds and releases through GitHub Actions.
